# Paths an automated fix may never touch. Extended regexes, one per line,
# matched against every path in the fix's diff. A hit holds the whole run
# and opens an issue instead of a PR. Read by post-merge-audit.yml (the
# structural check) and by the fixer prompt (so it doesn't waste turns).
# Portable: keep the generic rows, add repo-specific ones at the bottom.
^\.github/
(^|/)(auth|rls|polic|security|permission|secret|credential)[^/]*$
(^|/)migrations?/
\.sql$
(^|/)(payment|billing|licens|stripe|checkout)[^/]*
^\.env
\.(pem|key|p12)$
(^|/)(package(-lock)?\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|Cargo\.lock|go\.sum)$
# sorcmerc: engine config, export/release presets, the network relay
^project\.godot$
^export_presets\.cfg$
^tools/bug-relay/
